name: print-social-horse-pun-glitter-collage-post
title: Idiom post with glitter fries, cola can, horse and guest check
whatItIs: A pink sunburst 4:5 post with a lavender pill caption 'Say this instead of I'm hungry'. Cut-outs of glittery fries, a glitter cola can, a white horse on a blue shopping basket and a tilted restaurant guest check reading '1 horse' illustrate the idiom, with pastel stars around.
whatItMeans: Absurd, glossy and shareable; taking the idiom literally makes it memorable and funny.
techniques: Illustrate an idiom literally with unexpected cut-outs.
Use a real paper form (guest check) with handwritten script as a punchline.
Coat everyday objects with glitter for a maximalist Y2K feel.
Layer a pale sunburst background under the objects for energy.

vocabulary.definition: A real document reused as a graphic.
